scope: Executable stdlib-only Sourceborn native runtime from source lock through maturity, stopping before persistent writeback/new-node promotion.
hard_invariants: No LLM or provider dependency is required by the native runtime engines.
Source and Point Zero are locked before interpretation.
Event decomposition preserves exact source spans and starts with UNKNOWN or NOT_YET_DECODED Intent.
Parameter activation may only reference indexed existing IDs; residual does not create a new parameter.
Actor roles remain separate operational dimensions.
Multiple actor-state hypotheses do not split actor identity.
Relation linking does not merge identity and temporal order does not imply causality.
Combination generation uses bounded approved modes and never performs an unrestricted Cartesian product.
New wording does not count as a new Intent when structural Intent dimensions are equivalent.
Future-state reconstruction remains hypothesis-tagged unless directly source-stated or observed.
Synthetic hypotheses receive evidence predictions before promotion.
R-F-R stores structured checks, not private chain-of-thought.
Low score alone is not a falsifier.
Untested synthetic candidates cannot mature to M5.
Batch-3 performs zero persistent Brain writeback; that boundary belongs to Batch-4.
closure_condition: Active Batch-3 V1.1 integration fixture passes after Batch-2 link validation and full repo regression remains compatible.
acceptance_condition: P2_BATCH3_NATIVE_RUNTIME_RFR_V1_1.json reports PASS with no hard errors and persistent_write_count remains zero.
